components.name: Team Search
components.description: Search input uses the cool field background, a visible stroke and a blue focus outline.
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.65;color:var(--muted,#475467)}.ds-field input{font:inherit;min-height:44px;min-width:0;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--border,#7e8da1);border-radius:8px;background:var(--bg,#f4f7fb);color:var(--text,#101828);caret-color:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}.ds-field input::placeholder{color:var(--muted,#475467);opacity:1}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d4ed8);outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: White current task on the blue masthead; mobile uses equal square tabs.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="หน้าข้อมูล"><button aria-current="page">โปรแกรม</button><button>คู่เด่น</button><button>ผลการทำนาย</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px;background:var(--accent,#1d4ed8);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-nav button{font:inherit;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.65;min-height:44px;padding:8px 16px;border:0;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--surface,#ffffff);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-nav button:hover{background:#ffffff24}.ds-nav button[aria-current=page]{background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--surface,#ffffff);outline-offset:4px}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-nav{gap:0}.ds-nav button{flex:1;min-width:0;padding:8px 6px;border-radius:0}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.css: .ds-empty{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;padding:20px 24px;border:1px solid var(--border,#7e8da1);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--muted,#475467)}.ds-empty h2{margin:0 0 12px;color:var(--text,#101828);font-size:1rem;font-weight:600;line-height:1.5}.ds-empty p{margin:10px 0;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.8;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-empty button{margin-top:8px}.ds-button{font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:.875rem;line-height:1.65;min-height:44px;padding:9px 13px;border:1px solid var(--border,#7e8da1);border-radius:8px;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--text,#101828);cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-button:hover{background:var(--raised,#eff6ff);border-color:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}.ds-button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d4ed8);outline-offset:4px}.ds-button:disabled{cursor:default;color:var(--muted,#475467);opacity:.6}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Fixture Row
components.description: Selected recorded fixture with readable identities, an unknown score dash and explicit recorded state.
components.css: .ds-fixture{display:grid;grid-template-columns:2.875rem minmax(0,1fr) 2.5rem minmax(0,1fr) 1.125rem;gap:2px 8px;align-items:center;width:100%;min-height:60px;padding:8px 12px;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--divider,#d7dfeb);border-radius:0;background:var(--surface,#ffffff);color:var(--text,#101828);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-fixture:hover,.ds-fixture[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--raised,#eff6ff);color:var(--text,#101828)}.ds-fixture:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d4ed8);outline-offset:4px}.ds-time{grid-column:1;grid-row:1/3;font-size:.875rem;font-weight:500;text-align:left;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;white-space:nowrap}.ds-time small{display:block;font-size:.8125rem;font-weight:400;color:var(--muted,#475467)}.ds-home,.ds-away{min-width:0;font-size:1rem;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ds-home{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;text-align:right}.ds-away{grid-column:4;grid-row:1;text-align:left}.ds-score{grid-column:3;grid-row:1;min-height:28px;border-radius:5px;background:var(--bg,#f4f7fb);text-align:center;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-state{grid-column:2/5;grid-row:2;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.35;color:var(--muted,#475467);text-align:center}.ds-arrow{grid-column:5;grid-row:1/3;display:flex;justify-content:center;color:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}@media(max-width:767px){.ds-fixture{grid-template-columns:2.75rem minmax(0,1fr) 2.125rem minmax(0,1fr) 1rem;column-gap:5px;padding:8px}.ds-home{text-align:left}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-fixture{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Analysis Task Tabs
components.description: Four compact task tabs with a pale selected surface, blue type and bottom indicator.
components.css: .ds-tabs{display:flex;padding:0 8px;border-block:1px solid var(--divider,#d7dfeb);font-family:'IBM Plex Sans Thai',system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-tabs button{position:relative;flex:1;min-width:0;min-height:44px;padding:8px 4px;border:0;border-radius:0;background:transparent;color:var(--muted,#475467);font:inherit;font-size:.8125rem;line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 160ms ease-out,border-color 160ms ease-out}.ds-tabs button:hover{background:var(--raised,#eff6ff)}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--raised,#eff6ff);color:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}.ds-tabs button[aria-selected=true]::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:8px;right:8px;height:2px;background:var(--accent,#1d4ed8)}.ds-tabs button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent,#1d4ed8);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-tabs button{transition-duration:.01ms}}

components.name: Neutral Crest Fallback
components.description: Stable neutral initials substitute for missing media; this is not an official logo.

narrative.overview:
Compact, ordered and calm: white panes sit below a blue masthead, with red qualifying significant recorded states and the pitch mark. Thai text, full team identities, aligned scores and fine dividers carry the interface. Research shares the same materials and remains a secondary task.

This is the finished system extracted from the application, refreshing the incumbent document under the user's approved white/blue/red direction. It preserves the product name, local Thai type, provider identities and explicit distinction between recorded facts, estimates and unknown data. A competition being visible never implies that the model can analyse it. A recorded status never implies a current live guarantee. The approved written plan and the named FORM contract establish the direction; no generated seed or raster comp exists.
keyCharacteristics: White content, cool blue-grey structure, blue navigation and restrained red state.
Readable Thai text and full team names, with tabular scores and times.
Flat, divider-led panes and small curved controls.
Context-preserving selection, task tabs and truthful unavailable states.

rules.name: The Readable Selection Rule
rules.body: A selected fixture keeps Pitch Ink on Selection Wash, including time, team names and score. The generic blue pressed-button foreground must not leak into the pale programme row.

rules.name: The Named State Rule
rules.body: Red qualifies an explicit recorded state or problem; it never supplies the meaning alone. W/D/L form badges retain their letters.

rules.name: The Full Identity Rule
rules.body: Team names remain (16px) and wrap, including at narrow widths; do not shrink them to preserve a one-line row. Scores, times and probability values use tabular numerals. Dates and recorded times use the Thai locale with the Asia/Bangkok timezone; the shared date helpers explicitly use the Gregorian calendar.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Establish groups with dividers and tonal surfaces. Reserve overlays for existing filter and research tasks; do not add ornamental depth to fixture rows.

dos: **Do** show the actual recorded timestamp and distinguish unavailable data from an empty schedule.
**Do** keep the selected fixture's text dark, team names readable and complete, and target heights at least 44px.
**Do** preserve list context on selection/Back and allow necessary scrolling for enlarged text or short windows.
**Do** distinguish programme coverage, model eligibility and provider forecasts with explicit text.
**Do** retain evidence and sample size in research views, with technical provenance behind useful disclosures.
**Do** use genuine provider crests or the stable neutral initials fallback.
donts: **Don't** put a marketing hero, large research metrics or repeated warnings before the working programme.
**Don't** manufacture probabilities, scores, availability, official logos or live accuracy claims to fill a state.
**Don't** expose setup commands as the standard user recovery.
**Don't** add decorative gradients, glow, blur, hard offset shadows, invented eyebrow/kicker labels or glyph/emoji UI icons.
**Don't** use a decorative system display face or motion that competes with reading.
